description: This Kotlin source file defines the DeviceIdentityStore class responsible for securely storing, loading, and managing device identity information, including cryptographic keys, device ID derivation, digital signature creation and verification, and persistence to local storage.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: Data class representing the device's identity, including device ID, public key, private key, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityStore
classes.description: Class responsible for storing, loading, generating, and managing the device's identity, including cryptographic operations, file persistence, and ID derivation.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads existing device identity or creates a new one if none exists, updating the cache accordingly.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a given payload string using the device's private key, returning the signature encoded in URL-safe Base64.

methods.name: verifySelfSignature
methods.description: Verifies a signature for a given payload using the device's public key.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the device's public key encoded in URL-safe Base64.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the device identity from the storage file.

methods.name: readIdentity
methods.description: Reads and parses the device identity JSON from a given file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and writes the device identity to the storage file.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device identity with a fresh key pair and derives device ID by hashing the public key.

methods.name: deriveDeviceId
methods.description: Generates a device ID by hashing the raw public key bytes.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes the SHA-256 hash of input data and returns its hex string representation.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes input byte array into URL-safe Base64 string without padding.
